messages:
Elena: Quick q — final adoption hearing is in Manila on Apr 23, I need to travel for 7 days. What do I need to file for leave/reimbursement?
Michelle: Congrats, Elena! :tada: Please file the `Adoption Support Form` and a PTO request as soon as you have dates. Link: https://hr.redwood.com/forms/adoption-support
Elena: Thanks — do I file as parental leave or special leave? Also any docs required for payroll and benefits?
Michelle: Use the parental leave route for Redwood's adoption benefit (paid leave). Attach the court/hearing notice and the agency placement letter. If travel is required before placement finalization, note that in the form.
Elena: Who reviews the reimbursement for travel? Can Redwood cover expedited passport for the child / travel visa fees?
Megan (Payroll): Reimbursement is handled by Payroll, we need itemized receipts + the travel authorization from People Ops. Adoption-related travel is covered up to policy limits — send receipts to payroll@redwood.com and CC People Ops.
Elena: Policy limits? Is there a per-family cap?
Michelle: There is a one-time adoption assistance cap of $5,000 for eligible international adoptions. If you anticipate going over, ping me and we can discuss exceptions.
Raj: Heads up Elena — please confirm oncall coverage w/ Anya for Apr 22–28. We should document any handoffs in the runbook.
Anya: I can cover slack/oncall Apr 22–26, offsite checks on the 27th-28th are fine if you set up an async runbook. Please DM me the key playbooks.
Elena: Will do — I'll prepare a short handoff doc and share by Apr 10.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder: Submit `Adoption Support Form` and PTO by 1719600000 to ensure benefits/process before travel.
Michelle: Also file any visa/passport receipts under expense type `Adoption travel` in Concur. If you need an official letter from Redwood confirming purpose of travel, reply here and I'll draft it.
Elena: Could I get a sample subject line for the PTO request so payroll ties it to adoption benefit?
Michelle: Use: ```Subject: Parental leave (international adoption) — Elena — Apr 23–29```
Megan (Payroll): Quick payroll note: if your travel crosses a payroll cutoff and you need advance pay, submit an employee advance request and mark it `adoption travel`. We'll evaluate on a case-by-case basis.
Elena: Appreciate it. One last legal Q — what docs does immigration typically require for an adopted child traveling before passport issuance? Any Redwood experience to share?
Michelle: We're not legal experts, but HR has seen two common patterns: (1) court hearing notice + agency placement letter + notarized parental consent forms, or (2) embassy-issued temporary travel document. Ask your agency/immigration attorney to confirm. We can provide the company letter to support consular appointments.
Elena: Great, I'll loop in my agency. Thanks everyone — I'll upload the form and receipts once booked. :pray:
Raj: Safe travels and happy news :)
Anya: Congrats again, Elena!
PeopleOpsBot: Thread flagged as `needs-documentation`. People Ops will follow up to confirm forms uploaded.
